title: Crisis Response Planning and Management for the Arts
description: Crisis response planning and management is a critical aspect of managing arts organizations in order to maintain trust, manage reputation, and mitigate risks. Students will learn how arts and culture organizations can develop key relationships with emergency management agencies, local authorities, disaster relief and response organizations, and other related community partners to establish communication channels needed in a crisis situation. Additionally, students will explore how safety concerns within an organization can be discussed, perceived, and addressed as part of effective risk and crisis communication. Using real-world case studies and mock scenarios from various artistic disciplines and geographical contexts, students will develop crisis response plans that outline roles, responsibilities, messaging, and procedures for minimizing damage and mitigating future risk. Additionally, students will leave the course with a portfolio of practical documents, including an incident response model and organizational messaging protocol.
